caption:
Momo spent nine hours in 9 cm heels, and by evening her lower back and calves feel heavy.

Higher heels tend to tip your weight forward, so your back and calves may work harder to keep you balanced. You don't have to give them up: mixing heel heights and wearing comfy shoes on the commute can help.

Hybi's heel-day reset: a wall calf stretch and a half-kneeling hip stretch, 30 seconds each side.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 👠

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
